title: 第23章 黑马第24章 一鸣惊人
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 虽然众人对于孙冰的实力相当震惊，但偌大的外门大比乃是孙家的大事，根本不可能就因为出现一个孙冰而突然中止，因此只见孙立长老一声轻咳：“看来这一年当中我孙家弟子修炼还是相当刻苦的，但文无第一，武无第二，胜负还是要区分的。”
这才吸引了众多的弟子的目光，再次转头望向石台智商，可即便是这样，依然还是有不少人目光中闪烁着别样的情绪，心中暗道：看来今年会有一匹黑马了。
说实话，接下来大比上台的弟子心中都有点打鼓，毕竟珠玉在前，他们那一手本领根本就拿不出手啊，以往自己还稍稍有些自得，可到了现在根本就算是丢人现眼的玩意。
其中就算是有些弟子表现不差，境界也有那个样儿，而且还有一两手的绝活，放在刚刚开始还能吸引目光，但是此刻根本就不管用，当下所有弟子的兴致都不算高。
而这时，再次响起了孙冰的名字，一下子所有人的目光都被吸引了，甚至连去年第一的秦明也缓缓睁开了目光，进行查探。
再次站在石台上，孙冰静静的望着对方，只不过这一次的弟子并没有什么名气，甚至就连修炼境界也不过刚刚达到淬体境五层，对于孙冰而言，根本就不算是一个对手。
甚至孙冰自己还没有出手，对方就直接认输了，不过想想也是，这个人连往年的前十都没有取得，根本不是孙冰的对手，所以还不如直接认输，免得丢脸。
这让想要搜集孙冰情报的弟子们是一阵失望，毕竟未知的总是能够吸引人，秦明等人虽然是往年的前三，看得多了也就不觉得稀奇了，唯有新鲜人才能勾起他们的兴趣。
孙冰正好完美的符合这一点，别说看到过他出手了，甚至这里的很多人，整整十年见都没有见过孙冰一两面，显得格外的神秘，既然不能观看，当下就在高台之下进行讨论：
“没有想到今年竟然出现一个黑马了，这个孙冰当真是能隐忍啊，这么多年从来没听过啊，你们说今年大比前三应该是谁啊？”
“我觉得还是去年的那三个人，孙冰虽然说异军突起算得上一个黑马，但终究底蕴不足，明年的话倒是有可能。”一人摇头晃脑进行点评道。
但另一个人很明显不赞同他的言论，当即反驳道：“我倒不是这么认为的，孙冰既然今年站出来了，那心中就肯定有把握，而且对方到现在还没有展现出真正的实力，你又怎么能推断最终的胜利者？”
“呵呵，虽然孙冰没有显露出真正的实力，但你知道秦明等人有多恐怖么？去年就已经达到淬体境六层境界了，今天绝对突破至淬体境七层，这其中的差距可以算的上是天差地别，孙冰不过淬体境五层罢了，哪怕战力逆天，也不值一提。”
这言论中有理有据，在一想到实力的差距，此人完全不知道如何反驳，因此不由得止住了自己的声音。
当然了，不管台下弟子的讨论如何，都影响不了大比的最终结果，这还是需要手底下见真章的，在他们密切讨论的时候，石台上已经换了不少人。
至于孙冰则突然间发现，原先繁杂的弟子经过这几轮淘汰，弃权的弃权，被击败的击败，不知不觉只剩下最后十名弟子未尝一败了，而这十人就是今年的外门前十，孙冰甚至根本就没有出多少力，便已经外门前十了。
虽然孙冰并不知道往年的记录，但是通过台下们的讨论，已经知晓，这一届的外门前十与去年相比，至少改动了四个位置，可想而知竞争剧烈。
不过这样的情况正是高层所希望看到的，毕竟这就代表着家族拥有新鲜的血液，不至于衰败，甚至一改往日那严肃的面孔，脸上带着僵硬的慈祥：
“很好，你们都是孙家年轻的一代，只有相互之间的竞争才能够让家族更加的繁荣昌盛，今年的前十每人都有五瓶淬体丹，算是小小的奖励吧，接下来就是决胜前三的时候了。”
说这话的时候，目光从人群中扫视而过，在孙冰的身上停留的时间最长，其中蕴含的感情相当复杂，尤其是蕴含了浓浓的欣慰。
孙冰完全搞不清楚孙立长老眼中的含义到底如何，只知道对方似乎相当看重自己，当下倒也不在思索了，反而对于那丰厚的奖励相当满意，毕竟五瓶淬体丹，着实算是一笔横财啊，按照每两日一颗，也能保证一个月使用了。
“前三的争夺战，第一场孙冰”就见孙立长老淡淡的宣布，瞬间就吸引了所有人的目光，毕竟前十的战斗一般就很有看头了，而且第一场就是最神秘的孙冰，当然能够让众人满足。
在众多目光的注视之下，孙冰缓缓的走上了高台，而此刻的孙立长老，望了望手上的名单，依旧是那低沉的声音：“孙宇。”
“竟然是孙宇，看来这又是一场黑马争夺战啊，说起来几年的外门大比很有看头啊，竟然一次性出现两匹黑马。”
content_en:
Although everyone was quite shocked by Sun Bing's strength, the huge outer sect competition was a major event for the Sun family, and it was impossible for it to be stopped suddenly just because of the appearance of Sun Bing. Therefore, Elder Sun Li coughed lightly: "It seems that my Sun family disciples have practiced very hard this year, but we have no first place and we have no second place in martial arts. The winner still has to be determined."
This attracted the attention of many disciples, who turned to look at Shitai IQ again, but even so, there were still many people with different emotions flashing in their eyes, thinking secretly: It seems that there will be a dark horse this year.
To be honest, the disciples who came on stage next to Dabi were a little worried. After all, Zhu Yu was in front, and they couldn't show off their skills at all. In the past, they were a little complacent, but now they are simply considered embarrassing.
Even if some of the disciples performed well and had a certain state of mind, and had one or two unique skills, they would have attracted attention at the beginning, but it didn't work at all at the moment, and all the disciples were not very interested at the moment.
At this time, Sun Bing's name rang out again, and suddenly everyone's eyes were attracted. Even Qin Ming, who ranked first last year, slowly opened his eyes to investigate.
Standing on the stone platform again, Sun Bing looked at the opponent quietly, but this time the disciple was not well-known, and even his cultivation level had just reached the fifth level of the body tempering realm. For Sun Bing, he was not an opponent at all.
Even before Sun Bing made a move, the opponent immediately admitted defeat, but think about it, this person has not even achieved the top ten in previous years, and is not Sun Bing's opponent at all, so it is better to admit defeat directly to avoid embarrassment.
This made the disciples who wanted to collect information about Sun Bing feel disappointed. After all, the unknown can always attract people. Although Qin Ming and others were among the top three in previous years, they would not find it strange after seeing more. Only fresh people can arouse their interest.
Sun Bing fits this perfectly. Not to mention seeing him take action, many people here have not seen Sun Bing for ten years, which makes him extremely mysterious. Since they can't watch, they are discussing it under the high platform:
"I didn't expect that a dark horse would appear this year. This Sun Bing is really able to endure. I have never heard of him in so many years. Who do you think should be in the top three in this year's competition?"
"I think they are still the same three people from last year. Although Sun Bing is said to be a dark horse because of his sudden emergence, after all, he does not have enough background. It is possible next year." One person shook his head and commented.
But another person clearly disagreed with his remarks and immediately retorted: "I don't think so. Since Sun Bing has stepped forward this year, he must be sure of it, and the opponent has not shown his true strength until now. How can you infer the final winner?"
"Haha, although Sun Bing has not shown his true strength, do you know how terrifying Qin Ming and others are? Last year, he reached the sixth level of the Body Tempering Realm. Today, he will definitely break through to the seventh level of the Body Tempering Realm. The difference is huge. Sun Bing is only at the fifth level of the Body Tempering Realm. Even if his combat power is incredible, it is not worth mentioning."
This statement was well-founded. When he thought about the difference in strength, this person didn't know how to refute it, so he couldn't help but stop his voice.
Of course, no matter what the discussion among the disciples in the audience is, it will not affect the final result of the competition. This still requires the subordinates to see the truth. During their close discussion, many people have changed on the stone platform.
As for Sun Bing, he suddenly discovered that after these rounds of elimination of the originally complicated disciples, those who abstained, and those who were defeated, only the last ten disciples were left undefeated, and these ten were the top ten of the outer sect this year. Sun Bing was already in the top ten of the outer sect without even putting in much effort.
Although Sun Bing does not know the records of previous years, he already knows through the discussion in the audience that the top ten of the outer sect this year have changed at least four positions compared to last year. It is conceivable that the competition is fierce.
However, this situation is exactly what the top management wants to see. After all, it means that the family has fresh blood and will not decline. It even changes from the serious face of the past, with a stiff kindness on the face:
"Very good. You are all the younger generation of the Sun family. Only competition among each other can make the family more prosperous. Each of the top ten this year will have five bottles of body tempering pills. It is a small reward. Next, it is time to decide on the top three."
When he said this, his eyes swept through the crowd and stayed on Sun Bing for the longest time. The emotions contained in it were quite complicated, especially the deep relief.
Sun Bing was completely confused about the meaning in Elder Sun Li's eyes. He only knew that the other party seemed to value him very much. He didn't think about it at the moment. Instead, he was quite satisfied with the generous reward. After all, five bottles of body tempering pills were really a windfall. According to one pill every two days, it could be used for a month.
"The battle for the top three, the first one is Sun Bing." Elder Sun Li announced calmly, which instantly attracted everyone's attention. After all, the top ten battles are usually very interesting, and the first one is the most mysterious Sun Bing, which can certainly satisfy everyone.
Under the gaze of many eyes, Sun Bing slowly walked onto the high platform. At this moment, Elder Sun Li looked at the list in his hand, and his deep voice was still the same: "Sun Yu."
"It turned out to be Sun Yu. It seems that this is another dark horse competition. Speaking of which, the outer sect competition in the past few years was very interesting. Two dark horses appeared at once."
